payload.reason: The evidence provides comparative performance results of the proposed augmentation method (text smoothing) against other baselines, showing significant improvements in accuracy.

claims.text: Text smoothing outperforms the previously best method, BARTspan, by 1.17% in average accuracy across three datasets.
Text smoothing significantly improves various baseline data augmentation methods by margins ranging from 2.17% to 6.48%.
Text smoothing is the first method shown to improve a variety of mainstream data augmentation methods in a low-resource regime.
